dishes.name: Carpe Diem Eggs Benedict
dishes.description: House-smoked Canadian bacon or garlic bloomsdale spinach, poached eggs, English muffins & brown butter hollandaise, served with white cheddar grits & arugula salad; add Canadian bacon and spinach, or two silver dollar pancakes

dishes.name: Strawberry Pancakes
dishes.description: Buttermilk hotcakes, macerated strawberries, creme fraiche, strawberry-maple syrup, pistachio & cocoa nib crumble, chocolate mint; add a side of bacon, Canadian bacon or sausage

dishes.name: Warm Sugar Donut & Coffee
dishes.description: Fresh-made throughout the day and served with a cup of single-origin house roast; upgrade to bottomless coffee
